1) **Hunt mode**: When there are no known unsunk hits, it fires using a **probability/heatmap** computed from all valid placements of the remaining ship lengths on the current board (respecting misses and current hits). It then shoots the highest-probability unknown cell.  
2) **Target mode**: If there are one or more hits, it infers orientation (if possible) from contiguous hits; otherwise it tries adjacent cells. It chooses the next shot that extends the hit line if orientation is known, or otherwise the adjacent unknown cell with the best local heat/probability.
